item.tib: ye shes dbal mo'i skong ba khrag 'thung gnad kyi bskul pa
item.coloph: dbal mo khrag 'thung gnad kyi bskul pa zhes bya ba 'di/ sngon gyi dus su lde bon gyim tsha rma chung gis/ mang mkhar lcags 'phrang phug tu bzhugs tsam na/ ye shes dbal mo las la g.yel/ dgra bgegs mgo lo rgod/ lha 'dre gdug pa che/ g.yen khams mgo lo mtho ba de gzigs nas/ dbal mo las la btsud par dgongs nas/ 'bru sna tshogs kyi phye ma'i bshos bu la/ 'dab chags ri dwags g.yung dwags gcan zan (gzan) mi dang gzugs 'gros thams cad kyi sha khrag snying sna dang / rin chen dar zab sman 'bru dkar mngar rnams/ sgrub rten byas nas ting 'dzin dang snying pos 'bul lo/ dbal mo khrag 'thung ma gnas nas bskul ba'i le'u/ de nas rin chen gter du sbas so/ tha mar smon lam btsan nas dus 'dir brdol ba sogs/ dus sa pho stag gi lo la mang mkhar lcags 'phrang du gdan drangs nas/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen po rnams dang 'phrad par shog/
